blocks.zh: 非無菌藥品製程管控與製程中監測
blocks.en: Process Control and In-Process Monitoring for Nonsterile Drug Products

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解非無菌藥品 (Nonsterile Drug Products) 為何同樣需要有效的污染控制策略 (CCS)
blocks.en: Understand why nonsterile drug products also need an effective contamination control strategy (CCS)

blocks.zh: 掌握液態/半固態與固態劑型各自面臨的微生物污染風險差異
blocks.en: Grasp how the microbial contamination risks differ between liquid/semisolid and solid dosage forms

blocks.zh: 了解原物料與設備管控在非無菌製程中的關鍵角色
blocks.en: Understand the key role of raw material and equipment control in nonsterile processes

blocks.zh: 認識製程中監測 (In-Process Monitoring) 的規劃原則，包括生物負荷 (Bioburden) 與內毒素 (Endotoxin) 監測計畫的開發要點
blocks.en: Learn the principles for planning in-process monitoring, including the key points in developing bioburden and endotoxin monitoring plans

blocks.zh: 理解如何以風險為基礎建立合理的取樣計畫與管制限度
blocks.en: Understand how to establish a reasonable sampling plan and control limits on a risk basis

blocks.zh: 4.3 Nonsterile Drug Product Process Control 4.3 非無菌藥品製程管制
blocks.en: 4.3 Nonsterile Drug Product Process Control

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 非無菌藥品的 CCS (Nonsterile Product CCS)：許多人誤以為只有無菌注射劑才需要嚴格的污染控制策略。事實上，非無菌產品（如糖漿、乳膏、藥膏、錠劑等）同樣需要有效的 CCS。原因在於微生物污染可導致產品降解 (degradation)、效價損失 (loss of potency)，甚至使患者接觸到不安全水平的微生物及其副產物。
blocks.en: Nonsterile Product CCS: Many people wrongly assume that only sterile injectables need a rigorous contamination control strategy. In fact, nonsterile products (such as syrups, creams, ointments and tablets) also need an effective CCS. Microbial contamination can cause product degradation and loss of potency, and can even expose patients to unsafe levels of microorganisms and their by-products.

blocks.zh: Water Activity (水活性)：這是決定微生物能否在產品中生長的關鍵參數。液態及半固態劑型因水活性較高，本質上更容易遭受微生物污染。固態劑型（錠劑、乾粉）水活性較低，但並非完全免疫。
blocks.en: Water Activity: This is the key parameter that determines whether microorganisms can grow in a product. Liquid and semisolid dosage forms have higher water activity and are therefore inherently more susceptible to microbial contamination. Solid dosage forms (tablets, dry powders) have lower water activity but are not completely immune.

blocks.zh: Objectionable Organisms (不良微生物)：非無菌產品的監測不僅關注總微生物數量，還需針對特定「不良微生物」進行檢測，這取決於產品的給藥途徑及目標患者群。
blocks.en: Objectionable Organisms: Monitoring of nonsterile products looks not only at total microbial counts but also at specific "objectionable organisms", which depend on the route of administration and the target patient population.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像一下餐廳的食品安全管理。即使是不需要冷藏的乾糧（如餅乾、堅果），也需要防止蟲害和黴菌污染 -- 這就像固態劑型的管控。而湯品和醬料（液態/半固態產品）因為含水量高，更容易滋生細菌，需要更嚴格的溫度控制和保存劑（防腐劑）。但即便加了防腐劑，如果原料本身污染嚴重（例如水源不潔），再好的防腐劑也無法挽回 -- 這就是為什麼原物料管控如此重要。
blocks.en: Think of food safety management in a restaurant. Even dry goods that need no refrigeration (such as crackers and nuts) must be protected from pests and mold -- this is like the control of solid dosage forms. Soups and sauces (liquid/semisolid products), with their high water content, are more prone to bacterial growth and need stricter temperature control and preservatives. But even with preservatives, if the raw ingredients are heavily contaminated (for example, unclean water), the best preservative cannot rescue the product -- which is why raw material control is so important.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Burkholderia cepacia 的威脅：TR90 特別點名了 Burkholderia cepacia 這類微生物。它們能在製藥用水中存活且可能對防腐劑具有抗性，並且難以被傳統微生物檢測方法偵測。近年來 FDA 對此類微生物引起的非無菌產品召回案例高度關注。
blocks.en: The Burkholderia cepacia threat: TR90 specifically names microorganisms such as Burkholderia cepacia. They can survive in pharmaceutical water, may be resistant to preservatives, and are difficult to detect with conventional microbiological test methods. In recent years the FDA has paid close attention to recalls of nonsterile products caused by such organisms.

blocks.zh: Biofilm (生物膜) 風險：大型設備的死角、不易排水的區域容易形成生物膜。生物膜一旦形成，常規清潔難以根除，成為持續性污染源。TR90 引用了 PDA TR69 作為進一步參考。
blocks.en: Biofilm risk: Dead legs and poorly draining areas in large equipment are prone to biofilm formation. Once a biofilm has formed, routine cleaning can hardly eradicate it, and it becomes a persistent source of contamination. TR90 cites PDA TR69 for further reference.

blocks.zh: 防腐劑的局限性：防腐劑不是萬能的 -- 它們很少能對抗所有潛在污染菌種，且效力可能隨產品貨架期而降低。因此，製程中的微生物控制仍是不可或缺的第一道防線。
blocks.en: Limitations of preservatives: Preservatives are not a cure-all -- they rarely act against all potential contaminating species, and their efficacy may decline over the product shelf life. In-process microbial control therefore remains the indispensable first line of defense.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：假設你的工廠同時生產口服液劑和外用乳膏。在開發 CCS 時，需要分別評估：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: Suppose your site manufactures both oral liquids and topical creams. When developing the CCS, each needs to be assessed separately:

blocks.zh: 口服液劑：水活性高，需要關注製程用水的微生物品質、容器的清潔驗證、以及防腐劑效力測試 (Preservative Effectiveness Test, PET)
blocks.en: Oral liquids: high water activity, so attention is needed on the microbial quality of process water, cleaning validation of containers, and the Preservative Effectiveness Test (PET)

blocks.zh: 外用乳膏：除微生物外，還需注意異物 (foreign matter) 管控，因外觀品質同樣關乎產品可接受性
blocks.en: Topical creams: besides microorganisms, foreign matter control also needs attention, because appearance quality equally affects product acceptability

blocks.zh: 兩者共用的設備必須建立清潔確效，特別注意排水性 (drainability) 設計以防止生物膜形成
blocks.en: Shared equipment must have cleaning validation, with particular attention to drainability in the design to prevent biofilm formation

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼非無菌產品中的防腐劑不能完全取代製程中的微生物控制？請列舉至少兩個原因。
blocks.en: Why can preservatives in nonsterile products not completely replace in-process microbial control? List at least two reasons.

blocks.zh: 固態劑型（如錠劑）在哪些製程操作中特別容易引入微生物污染？
blocks.en: In which process operations are solid dosage forms (such as tablets) particularly prone to microbial contamination?

blocks.zh: 在非無菌產品的 CCS 中，為什麼 Burkholderia cepacia 被特別提及？它與一般微生物有何不同？
blocks.en: In the CCS for nonsterile products, why is Burkholderia cepacia specifically mentioned? How does it differ from ordinary microorganisms?

blocks.zh: 4.4 In-Process Monitoring 4.4 製程中監測
blocks.en: 4.4 In-Process Monitoring

blocks.zh: In-Process Monitoring (製程中監測)：這是了解製程、設施及產品處於受控狀態的窗口。它不僅僅是「取樣檢驗」，而是一個整體性 (holistic) 管控計畫的組成部分，涵蓋微生物控制、黴漿菌 (Mycoplasma)、病毒及微粒監測。
blocks.en: In-Process Monitoring: This is the window into whether the process, the facility and the product are in a state of control. It is more than "sampling and testing"; it is a component of a holistic control plan covering microbial control, Mycoplasma, viruses and particulate monitoring.

blocks.zh: Strategic Sampling Plan (策略性取樣計畫)：取樣不是越多越好，而是要「策略性」地規劃。考量因素包括：製程步驟的關鍵性、微生物侵入的易感性、中間體的促生長能力、以及下游的微粒去除步驟。
blocks.en: Strategic Sampling Plan: More sampling is not necessarily better; sampling must be planned "strategically". Factors to consider include the criticality of the process step, its susceptibility to microbial ingress, the growth-promoting capacity of the intermediate, and downstream particulate removal steps.

blocks.zh: Chain of Custody (監管鏈)：從取樣到最終結果審查的全程追溯能力。確保樣品的完整性和結果的可靠性。
blocks.en: Chain of Custody: The ability to trace everything from sampling through to the review of the final result, ensuring sample integrity and the reliability of results.

blocks.zh: 製程中監測就像醫院的感染管控計畫 -- 不是等病人出現感染症狀才處理，而是在各個可能的感染途徑上設置監控點。手術室有空氣微粒監測（環境監測），手術器械有滅菌確認（設備監測），醫護人員定期進行手部衛生稽核（人員監測）。同樣地，製藥製程中的監測也需要在各個潛在風險點進行策略性布局。
blocks.en: In-process monitoring is like a hospital infection control program -- rather than waiting until patients show symptoms of infection, monitoring points are placed along every possible route of infection. The operating room has airborne particle monitoring (environmental monitoring), surgical instruments have sterilization verification (equipment monitoring), and healthcare staff undergo regular hand hygiene audits (personnel monitoring). Likewise, monitoring in pharmaceutical processes needs to be deployed strategically at each potential risk point.

blocks.zh: 生物製品的額外要求：如果製造的是生物製品（使用細胞系統），監測計畫還必須包含 Mycoplasma（黴漿菌）和 Virus（病毒）的檢測，因為這些污染物能在細胞培養系統中增殖。
blocks.en: Additional requirements for biological products: If a biological product is manufactured (using cell systems), the monitoring plan must also include testing for Mycoplasma and viruses, because these contaminants can proliferate in cell culture systems.

blocks.zh: 目視檢查的重要性：TR90 特別提到對產品接觸設備、耗材和溶液進行「目視檢查 (visual inspection)」以偵測異物微粒風險，這是一項經常被低估但極為重要的管控手段。
blocks.en: The importance of visual inspection: TR90 specifically mentions "visual inspection" of product-contact equipment, consumables and solutions to detect the risk of foreign particulates, a control measure that is often underestimated but extremely important.

blocks.zh: 4.4.1 Bioburden/Endotoxin Monitoring 4.4.1 生物負荷／內毒素監測
blocks.en: 4.4.1 Bioburden/Endotoxin Monitoring

blocks.zh: Bioburden (生物負荷)：指在製程中間體或最終產品中存在的活微生物數量。它是評估製程微生物控制狀態的核心指標。
blocks.en: Bioburden: The number of viable microorganisms present in a process intermediate or the final product. It is the core indicator for assessing the microbial control status of a process.

blocks.zh: Endotoxin (內毒素)：革蘭氏陰性菌細胞壁的成分，即使微生物被過濾去除後，內毒素仍可能殘留。對注射劑而言，內毒素可引起熱原反應 (pyrogenic reaction)，是重要的安全指標。
blocks.en: Endotoxin: A component of the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria. Even after the microorganisms have been removed by filtration, endotoxin may remain. For injectable products, endotoxin can cause pyrogenic reactions and is an important safety indicator.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Assessment (風險評估)：監測計畫的開發應基於製程圖 (process mapping)，識別潛在的微生物侵入點和易於微生物增殖的操作步驟，而非簡單地在每個步驟都取樣。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Assessment: The monitoring plan should be developed on the basis of process mapping, identifying potential points of microbial ingress and the operating steps prone to microbial proliferation, rather than simply sampling at every step.

blocks.zh: EM History (環境監測歷史)：過往的環境監測數據是設計監測計畫的重要參考，特別是那些擴散性的、持續存在且難以消除的污染事件。
blocks.en: EM History: Past environmental monitoring data are an important reference for designing the monitoring plan, especially for contamination events that are widespread, persistent and difficult to eliminate.

blocks.zh: 設計生物負荷和內毒素的監測計畫就像設計一棟大樓的安防系統。你不會在每個房間都裝相同規格的攝影機，而是先繪製大樓平面圖（製程圖），找出最容易遭入侵的位置（如一樓大門、地下停車場入口、屋頂天窗），然後在這些高風險區域部署最密集的監控。同理，製程中生物負荷還原步驟（如過濾）之前是關鍵取樣點 -- 就像在安檢關卡之前確認是否有可疑人員。
blocks.en: Designing a bioburden and endotoxin monitoring plan is like designing the security system for a building. You would not install identical cameras in every room; instead you first draw the floor plan (the process map), identify the places most vulnerable to intrusion (such as the front entrance, the underground parking entrance and the rooftop skylight), and then deploy the densest monitoring in these high-risk areas. Similarly, the point before a bioburden reduction step (such as filtration) is the key sampling point -- like checking for suspicious persons before the security checkpoint.

blocks.zh: 反覆出現的偶發污染 (Recurring Sporadic Contaminations)：TR90 特別強調，這類看似隨機的污染事件可能暗示設備產品接觸面存在生物膜 (biofilm) 或製程區域存在普遍性環境污染。務必進行深入調查，不可僅視為偶發事件而忽略。
blocks.en: Recurring Sporadic Contaminations: TR90 particularly stresses that such seemingly random contamination events may indicate a biofilm on the product-contact surfaces of equipment or widespread environmental contamination in the process area. A thorough investigation must be carried out; do not dismiss them as merely sporadic events.

blocks.zh: 取樣本身的風險：取樣過程可能引入污染或產生偽陽性結果 (false-positive results)。因此，取樣方法和時機的設計必須兼顧資訊獲取的需求與製程完整性的保護。
blocks.en: The risk of sampling itself: The sampling process may introduce contamination or produce false-positive results. The design of sampling methods and timing must therefore balance the need to obtain information with the need to protect process integrity.

blocks.zh: 數據的統計挑戰：製程中生物負荷計數通常很低且不符合常態分佈 (not normally distributed)，因此不能使用傳統的參數統計方法（如 ±3 標準差）來建立有意義的管制限度。應採用科學的、基於風險的方法設定限度，並在累積足夠的歷史數據後持續評估調整。
blocks.en: Statistical challenges with the data: In-process bioburden counts are usually low and not normally distributed, so traditional parametric statistical methods (such as ±3 standard deviations) cannot be used to establish meaningful control limits. Limits should be set using a scientific, risk-based approach and continuously evaluated and adjusted once sufficient historical data have accumulated.

blocks.zh: 管制限度設定邏輯 Limit-Setting Logic
blocks.en: Limit-Setting Logic

blocks.zh: 由於生物負荷數據的特殊性，TR90 建議的限度設定邏輯如下：
blocks.en: Because of the particular nature of bioburden data, the limit-setting logic recommended by TR90 is as follows:

blocks.zh:
傳統方法（不適用）：
  Alert Limit = Mean + 2SD
  Action Limit = Mean + 3SD
  問題：數據低且非常態分佈，SD 無意義

建議方法：
  1. 風險評估 → 初始限度設定
  2. 長期製造 → 累積歷史數據
  3. 數據趨勢分析 → 限度評估與更新
  4. 網路層級的指標控管計畫 → 高層可見性
blocks.en:
Traditional approach (not applicable):
  Alert Limit = Mean + 2SD
  Action Limit = Mean + 3SD
  Problem: data are low and not normally distributed, so SD is meaningless

Recommended approach:
  1. Risk assessment → initial limit setting
  2. Long-term manufacturing → accumulate historical data
  3. Data trend analysis → limit evaluation and update
  4. Network-level metric control plan → high-level visibility

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：你正在為一個新的生物製劑原料藥 (Biologic DS) 製程建立生物負荷/內毒素監測計畫。關鍵步驟：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: You are establishing a bioburden/endotoxin monitoring plan for a new biologic drug substance (Biologic DS) process. Key steps:

blocks.zh: Step 1 - 製程圖繪製：從細胞培養、收穫、純化到最終原料藥，標註每個步驟的微生物侵入風險
blocks.en: Step 1 - Process mapping: From cell culture, harvest and purification through to the final drug substance, annotate the microbial ingress risk at each step

blocks.zh: Step 2 - 風險分級：開放操作 > 半封閉操作 > 完全封閉操作；促生長培養基 > 緩衝液 > 清潔用水
blocks.en: Step 2 - Risk ranking: open operations > semi-closed operations > fully closed operations; growth-promoting media > buffers > cleaning water

blocks.zh: Step 3 - 取樣點選擇：優先在生物負荷還原步驟（如過濾）之前取樣；在高風險的開放操作後取樣
blocks.en: Step 3 - Sampling point selection: Give priority to sampling before the bioburden reduction step (such as filtration); sample after high-risk open operations

blocks.zh: Step 4 - 初始限度：基於風險評估設定初始限度，隨製造批次累積數據後進行修訂
blocks.en: Step 4 - Initial limits: Set initial limits based on the risk assessment and revise them as data accumulate over manufacturing batches

blocks.zh: Step 5 - 趨勢監控：建立跨設施的指標控管計畫，確保管理層對微生物/內毒素控制狀態的可見性
blocks.en: Step 5 - Trend monitoring: Establish a cross-site metric control plan to ensure management has visibility of the microbial/endotoxin control status

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 建議在「生物負荷還原步驟之前」進行生物負荷監測，而非之後？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 recommend monitoring bioburden "before the bioburden reduction step" rather than after it?

blocks.zh: 反覆出現的偶發性污染事件可能暗示什麼潛在問題？應如何調查？
blocks.en: What underlying problems might recurring sporadic contamination events indicate? How should they be investigated?

blocks.zh: 為什麼傳統的 ±3 標準差方法不適用於製程中生物負荷數據的管制限度設定？你會建議採用什麼替代方法？
blocks.en: Why is the traditional ±3 standard deviation approach unsuitable for setting control limits for in-process bioburden data? What alternative approach would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 在設計取樣計畫時，如何平衡「獲取足夠監測資訊」與「避免取樣本身引入污染風險」這兩個目標？
blocks.en: When designing a sampling plan, how do you balance the two goals of "obtaining sufficient monitoring information" and "avoiding the contamination risk introduced by sampling itself"?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 非無菌產品同樣需要 CCS：微生物污染可導致產品降解、效價損失及患者安全風險。液態/半固態產品因水活性高而風險更大，但固態劑型也非完全免疫。
blocks.en: Nonsterile products also need a CCS: Microbial contamination can cause product degradation, loss of potency and risks to patient safety. Liquid/semisolid products carry greater risk because of their high water activity, but solid dosage forms are not completely immune.

blocks.zh: 防腐劑有其局限性：防腐劑無法對抗所有菌種且效力會隨時間下降，因此製程中的微生物控制是不可替代的基礎防線。
blocks.en: Preservatives have limitations: Preservatives cannot act against all species and their efficacy declines over time, so in-process microbial control is the irreplaceable foundational line of defense.

blocks.zh: 原物料與設備管控是關鍵：製程用水 (Process Water) 與大型設備是非無菌製程中最主要的污染源，特別需要注意 Burkholderia cepacia 和生物膜 (Biofilm) 問題。
blocks.en: Raw material and equipment control is key: Process water and large equipment are the main sources of contamination in nonsterile processes, and particular attention must be paid to Burkholderia cepacia and biofilm issues.

blocks.zh: 製程中監測需要策略性規劃：基於風險評估的取樣計畫應考量製程步驟的關鍵性、微生物侵入易感性、中間體促生長特性及下游去除能力。
blocks.en: In-process monitoring needs strategic planning: A risk-based sampling plan should consider the criticality of the process step, susceptibility to microbial ingress, the growth-promoting properties of the intermediate, and downstream removal capability.

blocks.zh: 生物負荷/內毒素監測計畫的核心原則：以製程圖為基礎進行風險評估，在生物負荷還原步驟前取樣，關注反覆出現的偶發污染，並採用風險為基礎的方法設定管制限度（非傳統統計方法）。
blocks.en: Core principles of a bioburden/endotoxin monitoring plan: Conduct a risk assessment based on the process map, sample before the bioburden reduction step, pay attention to recurring sporadic contamination, and set control limits using a risk-based approach (not traditional statistical methods).

blocks.zh: 數據管理與高層可見性：建立跨設施的指標控管計畫 (metric control plan)，確保管理層對微生物/內毒素控制狀態有充分掌握。
blocks.en: Data management and high-level visibility: Establish a cross-site metric control plan to ensure management has a full grasp of the microbial/endotoxin control status.
